about.text: What passes through the membrane when whey is ultrafiltered to make whey protein: water, lactose and the milk's minerals, with some acids, but no protein. Dried as an ingredient, or crystallised for its lactose. Crystallising the lactose out leaves delactosed permeate as the other half.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. Milk and whey powder

how.text: Lactose is about 87 % of the permeate's dry matter, so it is the raw material for lactose and for the cheap sweet powder in feed and food.
